title: German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin
summary: Bitcoin Magazine German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin A Leipzig judge has offered to dismiss the Movie2k criminal case if the defendant hands over 40,000 bitcoin, which would leave him about 16,000 coins worth roughly $1.02 billion. This post German Court Offers to Drop Movie2k Case for 40,000 Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
